verdicts.title: Automorphisms of algebraic varieties and infinite transitivity
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We survey recent results on multiple transitivity of automorphism groups of affine algebraic varieties. We consider the property of infinite transitivity of the special automorphism group, which is equivalent to flexibility of the corresponding affine variety. These properties have important algebraic and geometric consequences. At the same time they are fulfilled for wide classes of varieties. verdicts.title: Groups with finitely many conjugacy classes and their automorphisms
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:
We combine classical methods of combinatorial group theory with the theory of small cancellations over relatively hyperbolic groups to construct finitely generated torsion-free groups that have only finitely many classes of conjugate elements. Moreover, we present several results concerning embeddings into such groups.

verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns constructing torsion-free groups with finitely many conjugacy classes and realizing outer automorphism groups, with no mention of Coxeter diagrams, CNF formulas, SAT, or automorphism counting bounds relevant to the conjecture.
